'''Wyler''' was a [[Clone trooper|clone stormtrooper]] who served under the [[Galactic Empire]]. Wyler served under the command of [[Cody|Commander Cody]] and was [[Death|killed]] during a [[Mission to Desix|mission]] on the [[planet]] [[Desix]].<ref name="Solitary" />

==Biography==
In the [[Standard month|months]] following the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars]], Wyler served as a stormtrooper under the command of Commander [[Cody]] and was [[Mission to Desix|deployed]] in a [[Crosshair and Cody's team|squad]] to the planet of [[Desix]] to quash a [[Separatist Droid Army|Separatist]] holdout. [[Cloning|Clone]] [[commando]] [[Crosshair]] accompanied the squad in the mission.<ref name="Solitary" />

[[File:Wyler_and_nova_clones.png|left|thumb|290x290px|Wyler entered Desix City's stronghold alongside clone trooper Nova carrying a flamethrower]]
Aboard a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]], Wyler and his<ref name="Solitary AD" /> squad members were briefed by Cody about the situation on Desix. As the shuttle approached [[Desix City]], it was shot down by reprogrammed [[B1-series battle droid|battle droids]] defending the Separatist stronghold and crashed in its outer perimeter. Wyler, along with Cody, Crosshair, and several other clone stormtroopers managed to survive the crash. Those who were fit enough to continue began to advance into the city with the intent of rescuing [[Governor]] [[Grotton]], who was being held as a hostage. As the squad entered the stronghold, Cody divided his forces to cover more ground, and took Crosshair, Wyler, and [[trooper]] "[[Nova (clone trooper)|Nova]]" with him into the stronghold's north access. As the squad moved deeper into the stronghold, they were ambushed by a [[droideka]]. Wyler failed to react in time, and was subsequently killed in a barrage of blaster fire by the Separatist [[droid]].<ref name="Solitary" />

==Equipment==
As a clone stormtrooper, Wyler wore standard-issue [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] that was devoid of any markings or color. He was equipped with a [[BT X-42 heavy flame projector]].<ref name="Solitary" />
